method.scope: Only the five allowlisted supplied text files; no scans, OCR, PDFs, web, or other returns.
method.matching: Accent/case-folded literal search plus declared TeX/Unicode typography normalization; phrase whitespace may span lines within one locator; no translation or semantic expansion.
method.terms: Q/N explicit metadata; tables inherit named Q/N ranges and slash references; table Search/search clauses retained; T title quotations/words and RQ frozen-reading quotations/formulas follow section rules.
method.short_terms: Math objects and alphabetic terms of at most three letters use alphabetic token boundaries; explicitly truncated longer words remain substring searches.
method.counts: Counts are distinct matched line spans, merging the two search modes; examples are capped and do not enumerate every occurrence.
method.sampling: Global query examples follow source order; per-item examples prefer the item's declared CT scans, HU page scopes, and RS IDs, then longer queries.
method.non_reproduction: No context snippets or source bodies are emitted. Only query terms, source hashes, match counts, and text/scan/page-scope/heading coordinates are retained; original sources remain in the user's attachments.
method.locators: CT scan locators are exact; HU locators are the synthesis's declared page scope/heading, not an independently verified unique manuscript page; both HU heading and pagerange macro are retained when they differ.
method.caution: A lexical hit verifies neither the manuscript reading nor the mathematical claim; a zero-hit term does not exclude a thematic match. CT/CN and RS remain unreviewed supplied leads; HU remains Hua's credited interpretation.
method.subordinate_rows: S15a-h belong to Q10 and are not additional numbered Q/N/B/SF/W/C/T/RQ definitions; bibliography and RS crosswalk rows are not duplicate items.
